name: waypipe (remote Linux windows)
purpose: `waypipe` 0.11.3 (+ the ARGB video patch) and `socat`: a Linux window of another machine (.58) shown on the phone's KWin as a web window, over TCP (docs/research/native-window-remoting.md §8.7); `powos-remote-app HOST:PORT APP_ID` (targets/android/session) dials such a window through powos-open-task, so KWin shows it like a launched app; command-line tools, nothing runs until a check or the user starts one
installedBy: targets/android/rooted/powos-deploy.sh (our package, targets/android/pkgs/waypipe; pkgs/socat; powos-remote-app installed to /usr/local/bin by the same deploy)
